# Pierre Elliott Trudeau High School AI Club

The Pierre Elliott Trudeau High School AI Club helps students explore, build, and innovate with artificial intelligence. We focus on practical learning, hands-on project work, and student collaboration.

We teach real skills in AI, app development, web design, 3D modeling, and presentation-building. Our club emphasizes research-backed learning, testing, and practical application in school and future careers.

We also host engaging competitions with real prizes, making the club a fun and rewarding place to learn and collaborate.

The club is designed to be welcoming and inclusive, where students can make friends, work on cool projects, and build together.

Website: https://www.pethsaiclub.tech/
